name: page-catalog-previews
goal: Implemented page cards show their own recorded screenshot at the selected revision; planned pages keep their design preview.

evidence: The catalog selects only plan images and leaves implemented pages blank despite existing sealed screenshots. Bind each visual unit to scenario, state and viewport; retain tested-commit provenance and plan previews.
Unchanged catalog regression returns null instead of the recorded thumbnail; the manifest rejects preview bindings. Logs: page-preview-images/catalog-red.log and manifest-red.log.
Bound page cards to exact recorded screenshots, kept planning designs, and added pinned-state validation, cleanup and signature selection guards.

Catalog, manifest, binding and collision regressions pass. Browser: 7 passed across local/hosted desktop, tablet, mobile, historical and missing evidence. Strict gate tests reject invalid previews; Mac signing rejects unavailable identities.
